title: Implemented new "@export_translation" annotation.
body:
## What problem(s) does this PR solve?

- Closes https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/10139
- Closes https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/104021

## Motivation

- I wanted to add translations to my game, but I couldn't find a way to mark exported `String`s to be include in the translation template. Then I found the above-mentioned proposal which suggested a workaround of appending `String` names with `_text`. This worked, but is not intuitive and forces to name variables a certain way. Also this was not documented.

## Changes

- Added new `@export_translation` annotation which sets the new `PROPERTY_USAGE_TRANSLATION` `PropertyUsageFlag`.
- This annotation works for `String`, `Array[String]`, and `PackedStringArray`. Before, you could not include `String` arrays in the template, even by appending the name with `_text`.   This can be useful, if you want to export an array of strings from which you pick at runtime and want the strings to be translated.
- When parsing `PackedScene`s for translation, exported sub-resources and arrays that contain them are now parsed as well. Before (at least by my testing) sub-resources were not parsed for the translation template, which seems like an oversight to me so I implemented this as well.   This is useful when implementing a dialog system, where you'd have a `Dialog` resource which has an array of `DialogLine` resources which have `String`s with the `@export_translation`.
- Added new documentation.

## Compatibility

- These changes will probably break some projects, where developers found out they can append `String` names with `_text` to include them in the translation template. But as I mentioned earlier, this is a workaround and isn't documented, so I doubt a lot of people used this.
- The new annotation is only checked for user created things. So the built-in `Control`s are not affected and their properties are still matched against `lookup_properties` as before.

## Additional information

AI was used to inquire how the back-end works. All changes are human written.

## Ending notes

I find this addition to be very useful (at least for me), because using annotations is much more explicit and less bug prone, than having to add `_text` to string names. Plus by adding sub-resource and array parsing I can create translatable dialog resources by just annotating a few strings.

If you notice any problems please tell me so I could fix them!
The worst that could happen is I learn more stuff :)

I have never contributed to any project, but found it very fun! So after this I think I will tackle:
- https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/109256
- https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/73565
- other translation related improvements.

@@ -116,6 +116,7 @@ enum PropertyUsageFlags {
 	PROPERTY_USAGE_EDITOR_BASIC_SETTING = 1 << 27, //for project or editor settings, show when basic settings are selected.
 	PROPERTY_USAGE_READ_ONLY = 1 << 28, // Mark a property as read-only in the inspector.
 	PROPERTY_USAGE_SECRET = 1 << 29, // Export preset credentials that should be stored separately from the rest of the export config.
+	PROPERTY_USAGE_TRANSLATION = 1 << 30, // Mark `String` property to be included in the translation template.
 
 	PROPERTY_USAGE_DEFAULT = PROPERTY_USAGE_STORAGE | PROPERTY_USAGE_EDITOR,
 	PROPERTY_USAGE_NO_EDITOR = PROPERTY_USAGE_STORAGE,

@@ -3106,6 +3106,9 @@
 		<constant name="PROPERTY_USAGE_SECRET" value="536870912" enum="PropertyUsageFlags" is_bitfield="true">
 			An export preset property with this flag contains confidential information and is stored separately from the rest of the export preset configuration.
 		</constant>
+		<constant name="PROPERTY_USAGE_TRANSLATION" value="1073741824" enum="PropertyUsageFlags" is_bitfield="true">
+			Used to mark a [String], [Array][lb][String][rb], or [PackedStringArray] to be included in the translation template.
+		</constant>
 		<constant name="PROPERTY_USAGE_DEFAULT" value="6" enum="PropertyUsageFlags" is_bitfield="true">
 			Default usage (storage and editor).
 		</constant>

@@ -762,6 +762,17 @@
 				[b]Note:[/b] Avoid storing lambda callables in member variables of [RefCounted]-based classes (e.g. resources), as this can lead to memory leaks. Use only method callables and optionally [method Callable.bind] or [method Callable.unbind].
 			</description>
 		</annotation>
+		<annotation name="@export_translation">
+			<return type="void" />
+			<description>
+				Export a [String], [Array][lb][String][rb], or [PackedStringArray] property and mark them to be included in the translation template.
+				See also [constant PROPERTY_USAGE_TRANSLATION].
+				[codeblock]
+				@export_translation var character_biography
+				@export_translation var npc_dialogs: Array[String]
+				[/codeblock]
+			</description>
+		</annotation>
 		<annotation name="@icon">
 			<return type="void" />
 			<param index="0" name="icon_path" type="String" />
